title: Number Of People That Can Be Seen In A Grid
statement:
# Number of People That Can Be Seen in a Grid

You are given an m × n grid of positive heights. A person can see another person to their right in the same row or below them in the same column when everyone between them is strictly shorter than both endpoints. Return an m × n grid containing the number of people visible from each position.

## Examples

```text
Input: heights = [[3,1,4,2,5]]
Output: [[2,1,2,1,0]]
```

```text
Input: heights = [[5,1],[3,1],[4,1]]
Output: [[3,1],[2,1],[1,0]]
```

## Constraints

- 1 <= heights.length <= 400
- 1 <= heights[i].length <= 400
- 1 <= heights[i][j] <= 10^5.
